# netactuate_access_control_subnet (Data Source)

WARNING: Adding the first user access control subnet can restrict account access to that subnet. Include your own current address or network before applying.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_access_control_subnet" "example" {
  access_control_subnet_id = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_control_subnet_id` (String) Access control subnet ID returned by the API.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `label` (String) Human-readable label for the access control subnet.
- `subnet` (String) Source network in CIDR notation.
